nodes.summary: The sequence of natural numbers with $a(0) = 4$, $a(1) = 16$ and, for every natural number $n$, $a(n + 2) = \lfloor (a(n + 1)^2 + a(n) - 1) / a(n) \rfloor - 1$ if $n$ is even and $a(n + 2) = \lfloor a(n + 1)^2 / a(n) \rfloor + 1$ if $n$ is odd.
nodes.title: The sequence OEIS A022030

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 4$, the sequence $a$ of OEIS A022030 satisfies $a(n) = 4a(n - 1) - a(n - 3) + a(n - 4)$, with the subtraction taken in the natural numbers (truncated at $0$).
nodes.title: Barker's linear recurrence for A022030 holds

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $n \ge 4$, the sequence $a$ of OEIS A022030 satisfies $a(n) = 4a(n - 1) - a(n - 3) + a(n - 4)$, with the subtraction taken in the natural numbers (truncated at $0$).
